_archive: Both blank disables the archive entirely: nothing posted, no outbox, no polling.
_jobs: ls_jobs.py only. Run `ls_jobs.py --check` to see what these resolve to before enabling the service.
_archive_media_root: Blank derives it: nas_path with archive_media_prefix walked back off the end.
_archive_quarantine_dir: Blank derives it: the sibling of the media root named quarantine.
_fetch: The allowlist that matters. The archive has its own copy, but that one is a courtesy to whoever is pasting; this one decides.
_music: Songs the archive keeps a copy of. music_probe reads a page and needs nothing here; music_fetch writes into the media tree under archive_music_prefix.
_archive_music_format: yt-dlp -f. The format policy lives on this side on purpose: the archive names an id and a verb and never says what to fetch. bestaudio/best for an audio-only collection.
